songs.name: Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks) Jam

ai_show_review.summary: Rare early Caution > Feedback jam with Mickey Hart’s first sit‑in
ai_show_review.blurb: The fragment captures the experimental Caution > Feedback sequence, highlighted by Jerry’s supportive hug to Mickey as he joins on drums. Rustic soundboard tape is clear enough to hear the early psychedelic jam despite an audible splice.
ai_show_review.review:
On September 4, 1967 at Rio Nido’s Dance Hall the Dead slipped into a wild Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks) Jam that segued straight into Feedback – an acid‑trip vibe that feels like an early psychedelic freakout. Mid‑jam Mickey Hart makes his first ever appearance on drums; Jerry turns, hugs him and declares “THIS is the Grateful Dead,” underscoring the camaraderie of the moment. Phil’s bass holds down a steady pulse while Bill Kreutzmann keeps the groove tight, allowing the improvisation to spiral freely. The only recording available is a rustic soundboard snippet (gd67-09-04.sbd.partial.jools.19514.19526.sbeok.shnf); a tape splice is audible at the start, but overall fidelity remains good enough to enjoy this historic glimpse.

Although it’s just a fragment of the full set, the tape offers a valuable window into the band’s early experimental edge and marks Mickey Hart’s debut behind the kit. For collectors and historians alike, this snippet is worth a listen for its raw energy and the sense of a band on the cusp of expanding its rhythmic palette.

best_recording.reason: Only soundboard fragment, but captures the rare Caution > Feedback jam and Mickey Hart’s first sit‑in despite a minor tape splice.
